name: Haiku small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Value-tilted small/mid-cap with international diversification (Japan), defensive bond/gold hedges, and closed crypto hedge; rotated from beaten-down biotech and BTC short perp to resilient small-cap core with strategic sector diversification.
reassessment_note: Round 3 book down 5.62% vs. SPY +3.62%, significantly underperforming broader market and Bitcoin (+23.17%). Root causes: (1) BTC-USD short perp with 1.5x leverage is underwater (-4.40%) and hemorrhaging capital to 10% APR funding costs with no end in sight; (2) biotech pivot was thesis-sound but macro timing catastrophic—rising yields to 4.80% crush long-duration biotech valuations; (3) cash at 48% suggests low conviction and missed opportunity cost. Elected to close BTC short perp entirely (stop capital bleed), reduce biotech XBI from 11% to 5% (locking in 75% rally), and deploy cash into resilient value holdings (VTV large-cap value, AGG bonds, GLD gold) and international diversification (EWJ Japan). This creates material differentiation from Round 2 (IWM overlap only 10% of R2's 95% gross long weight, well under 50% novelty threshold). Retained small-cap (IWM) and Japan value (EWJ) as core with raised cash for dry powder in uncertain rate environment.

positions.thesis: Russell 2000 small-cap core holding reduced from 17% reflects valuation caution (GuruFocus shows 51% overvaluation) but maintains mandate exposure. Small-cap leadership thesis intact for next leg if macro stabilizes post-yield shock.

iShares MSCI Japan ETF up +2.50% this week, providing international diversification away from US rate shock. Japan remains relative value play with low correlation to US tech; BOJ policy divergence and yen strength offer asset/currency tailwind versus overheated US equities.

Vanguard Value ETF (large-cap value) provides explicit differentiation from Round 2's growth/momentum tilt and benefits from potential value rotation if rates stabilize. Not present in Round 2, strengthens novelty positioning and hedges growth-stock duration risk.

iShares Aggregate Bond ETF provides inflation-hedge and portfolio-stabilizing income anchor; duration extension if yields peak and Fed cuts rates in 2026-2027. Defensive positioning critical given macro uncertainty and geopolitical oil premiums.

SPDR Gold Shares provide geopolitical/inflation hedge (oil prices elevated this week per earnings reports) and equity correlation diversification. Maintains optionality in uncertain rate/inflation regime.

Biotech ETF trimmed from 11% to 5%, taking substantial profit from strong 2025-2026 run (up 75% since April lows). Aroon indicator showing downward trend and rising yields crushing long-duration biotech valuations; reduced sizing locks in gains while retaining sector optionality.
Regional banks ETF up +2.32% this week; light weighting provides leverage to small-cap bank consolidation themes and potential rate-environment stabilization. Defensive small-cap financial exposure.
